title: A patient portal people actually use
excerpt: Staff augmentation for a healthcare provider rebuilding its patient portal.

image.alt: Doctor reviewing results with a patient

meta.headline: **Scaling** a healthcare team **without slowing** the roadmap.
meta.summary: Five engineers and two QA analysts joined Northwind's product team to rebuild the patient portal, adding online booking, test results and secure messaging.

blocks.body: Northwind Health's portal was ten years old and barely used. Their product team had a clear roadmap but not enough hands to deliver it while keeping the legacy system running.

tallImage.alt: Doctor reviewing results with a patient

blocks.title: Solution
blocks.body: We embedded five full-stack engineers and two QA analysts under Northwind's engineering manager. They took the booking, results and messaging epics end to end, with automated accessibility and regression checks in every release.
